name: Ex-Husband Wants to Get Back Together Every Day
overview: After a bitter divorce, Qin Ziyu and her cold ex-husband Wei Yichen are thrust into a tragic romance novel where they must relive a predetermined love-hate story to escape. Seizing control of the narrative, Qin Ziyu turns the suffering back on him—only to uncover his long-suppressed devotion as the line between revenge and love begins to blur.
